edges.rationale: File imports express and instantiates an express.Router() (line 1, 8).
File imports multer and configures bulkQuestionUpload middleware (line 2, 11-22).
XLSX.read and XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json used to parse Excel uploads (line 3, 143-147).
dbHelpers.find/insertOne/insertMany/updateById/softDelete/restoreFromTrash drive nearly every write path.
Question.findByIdentifier(req.params.id) used in GET /questions/:id (line 454).
resolveAssetAccessUrl(asset) returns the signed image URL for the question detail endpoint.
File defines the bulk upload route and the multer config in this single module.
All admin question REST routes are defined in this router file.
syncTestStats helper is declared at the top and reused by create/update/delete/duplicate/reorder/bulk.
parseQuestionsCsv, parseJson, parseQuestionsSpreadsheet, mapBulkRowToQuestionPayload co-located in the file.
VALID_QUESTION_FIELDS, INTEGER_FIELDS, ARRAY_FIELDS, FLEXIBLE_INTEGER_FIELDS, safeParseInt live in this module.
fetchQuestionsWithRelations is defined here and called by list/practice/orphaned routes.
GET /questions/export handler lives in this router and streams a BOM CSV.
After inserting chunks, the bulk route looks up distinct test_ids and calls syncTestStats for each.
Bulk handler dispatches to parseQuestionsCsv / parseJson / parseQuestionsSpreadsheet and then mapBulkRowToQuestionPayload.
POST/PUT/DELETE/reorder all invoke syncTestStats(testId) to keep tests.total_questions/total_marks consistent.
GET list, /practice, /orphaned all delegate to fetchQuestionsWithRelations with different filters.
PUT /questions/:id filters req.body through VALID_QUESTION_FIELDS and INTEGER_FIELDS before update.
POST /questions encodes the explicit isPractice bug-fix rationale as inline logic.
useQuery/useMutation/useQueryClient are imported from @tanstack/react-query.
useParams, useNavigate, Link imported from react-router-dom.
useAuth() supplies user; user.role === admin gates the admin control bar.
All API calls (exam-info, exam details, updates, yearly-data, categories, save, enrolled-exams) go through the shared api client.
RichTextEditor output and stored description/syllabus are piped through sanitizeHtml before render.
toast.success / toast.error fire from the save mutation callbacks.
~40 lucide icons (Bell, Edit2, Save, ShieldCheck, etc.) are imported for the master UI.
Breadcrumb is rendered with Home/Exams/Category/Current items.
RichTextEditor is defined inline at the top of ExamMasterPage.jsx.
The useQuery for exam-master is declared inside ExamMasterPage and orchestrates four sub-fetches.
The admin control bar, mode state, and saveMutation are part of ExamMasterPage.
Six tabs (overview/syllabus/pattern/updates/archive/subcategories) are rendered conditionally in the same file.
Enrollment check effect and CTA buttons are in this page.
The four-tile quick-info grid is rendered inside the hero section.
contentEditable div uses dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: sanitizeHtml(value || '') }} to prevent XSS on initial mount.
Query function hits /api/exam-info, /api/exams/:id, /api/exam-info/:id/updates, /api/exam-info/:id/yearly-data, /api/exam-categories.
Edit mode mounts RichTextEditor for description and syllabus fields.
saveMutation uses useMutation and queryClient.invalidateQueries(['exam-master']) on success.
Syllabus and Overview tabs embed RichTextEditor when in edit mode.
Enrollment status is fetched via api.get('/api/users/enrolled-exams').
Hero stats derive from masterData.yearly and masterData.content returned by the exam-master query.
File header comment (Logic from ExamDetails.jsx + Exam.jsx) and the unified admin/view mode express the consolidation rationale.
Both files participate in the exam/question admin surface but target different domains (questions CRUD vs exam intelligence); shared dependency is infrastructure (auth/api), not a direct call.
The Question model sits alongside dbHelpers in the data layer and likely uses the same pg pool; Question.findByIdentifier wraps the helpers pattern.
